template: hump_decay(group_normalize(multiply(if_else(less(days_from_last_change(vec_skewness({version})), 10), 1.2, 0.8), if_else(greater(group_rank(add(multiply(0.6, group_zscore(vec_skewness({version}), industry)), multiply(0.4, group_zscore(vec_kurtosis({version}), industry))), industry), 0.8), multiply(1.0, if_else(greater(group_rank(vec_stddev({version}), industry), 0.5), 1.3, 0.7)), if_else(less(group_rank(add(multiply(0.6, group_zscore(vec_skewness({version}), industry)), multiply(0.4, group_zscore(vec_kurtosis({version}), industry))), industry), 0.2), multiply(-1.0, if_else(less(group_rank(vec_stddev({version}), industry), 0.5), 1.3, 0.7)), 0))), industry), 0.02)
idea: 多阶矩波动率自适应复合策略：融合偏度与峰度（6:4加权）构建分布形态综合指标，根据个股历史波动率（vec_stddev）动态调整信号强度（高波动放大1.3倍，低波动压缩至0.7倍），并叠加10日新鲜度滤镜（近期变化 boost 1.2倍），最终采用hump_decay进行曲率控制以平滑权重变迁。
expression_list: hump_decay(group_normalize(multiply(if_else(less(days_from_last_change(vec_skewness(anl85_version)), 10), 1.2, 0.8), if_else(greater(group_rank(add(multiply(0.6, group_zscore(vec_skewness(anl85_version), industry)), multiply(0.4, group_zscore(vec_kurtosis(anl85_version), industry))), industry), 0.8), multiply(1.0, if_else(greater(group_rank(vec_stddev(anl85_version), industry), 0.5), 1.3, 0.7)), if_else(less(group_rank(add(multiply(0.6, group_zscore(vec_skewness(anl85_version), industry)), multiply(0.4, group_zscore(vec_kurtosis(anl85_version), industry))), industry), 0.2), multiply(-1.0, if_else(less(group_rank(vec_stddev(anl85_version), industry), 0.5), 1.3, 0.7)), 0))), industry), 0.02)
